candidates.source_name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR) — vyhľadávanie podľa obchodného mena
candidates.why_relevant: Legacy but still-primary public interface to the Slovak commercial register. Entity detail pages ('výpis') list štatutárny orgán (predstavenstvo / konateľ), prokúra, dozorná rada, organizačné zložky and share capital, each with a legal effective date (dátum vzniku/zániku funkcie). For banks, payment institutions and their SK subsidiaries this is the ground-truth record of every leadership and organisational change, usually available before or without any press release. Also exposes historical entries via 'úplný výpis'.
candidates.legal_status: public register established by Act 530/2003 Z. z.; extracts free for information purposes
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML scrape of subject detail pages (vypis.asp?ID=..&SID=..&P=0 for aktuálny, P=1 for úplný výpis) for a watchlist of bank/PSP IČOs; diff structured blocks (Štatutárny orgán, Prokúra, Dozorná rada, Organizačná zložka, Základné imanie) between runs. Respect low request rate; legacy ASP, no API.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + direct fetch of the search form to enumerate its criteria
queries_used: obchodný register SR ORSR zmena štatutárneho orgánu banka konateľ zápis výmaz
orsr.sk vyhľadávanie podľa predmetu činnosti úplný výpis zbierka listín uložené listiny

candidates.source_name: ORSR — vyhľadávanie podľa priezviska a mena osoby (person search)
candidates.why_relevant: Person-centric index over the commercial register: given a named executive, returns every SK entity where they are or were a registered officer. This is the single highest-value tool for tracking an individual banker's or payments executive's moves across entities, and for detecting new appointments by watching known-person profiles. Inverse of the entity-first view.
candidates.legal_status: public register; contains personal data lawfully published under the Commercial Register Act
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query per tracked executive surname/first name; parse result table of entities and roles; keep person->entity edges as a graph and diff over time. Handle Slovak diacritics and female surname suffix (-ová) variants.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from the ORSR search form's alternative-criteria links
queries_used: orsr.sk vyhľadávanie podľa predmetu činnosti úplný výpis zbierka listín uložené listiny
local_language_terms_used: vyhľadávanie podľa priezviska a mena osoby

candidates.source_name: Elektronické služby Obchodného registra (sluzby.orsr.sk) — nový portál MS SR
candidates.why_relevant: The modernised Ministry of Justice ORSR portal (search + electronic filing services). Expected to be the long-term successor to orsr.sk and likely to expose cleaner, more structured entity views and document access; worth tracking in parallel so collection does not break when the legacy portal is retired.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect the portal's XHR/JSON endpoints behind the search UI; prefer those over HTML scraping. Keep legacy orsr.sk scraper as fallback.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result + MS SR user manual PDF
queries_used: obchodný register SR ORSR zmena štatutárneho orgánu banka konateľ zápis výmaz
local_language_terms_used: návrh na zápis zmeny zapísaných údajov

candidates.why_relevant: Lists the documents deposited for each entity — spoločenská zmluva/stanovy, rozhodnutia valného zhromaždenia (appointments/removals), podpisové vzory of new officers, projekty premien (merger/demerger plans), účtovné závierky. The list itself is a free change-signal timeline: a new 'rozhodnutie jediného spoločníka' or 'podpisový vzor' filing dates a leadership move precisely, even before the register entry is visible elsewhere.
candidates.access_status: index free; certified copies of deeds subject to court fee
candidates.legal_status: public; everyone may inspect and make copies (fee for official copies)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the zbl.asp document list per watched IČO; treat new rows (document type + date) as events. Do not attempt paywalled certified copies.
queries_used: orsr.sk vyhľadávanie podľa predmetu činnosti úplný výpis zbierka listín uložené listiny

candidates.source_name: Obchodný vestník SR (Commercial Bulletin) — vyhľadávanie zverejnených formulárov
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory daily gazette (Act 200/2011 Z. z.). Mandatory publication venue for projekty premien (merger/demerger/legal-form-change plans) at least one month before the approving general meeting, plus liquidations, bankruptcy/restructuring, convocations of general meetings and share-capital notices. Gives the earliest legally-dated warning of a bank/fintech reorganisation, ahead of the register entry itself.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll of the published-forms search filtered by IČO watchlist and by section (Premeny/Konkurzy a reštrukturalizácie/Valné zhromaždenia); or ingest the daily issue PDFs. Alternatively consume via the Slovensko.Digital Obchodný vestník API/SQL dump for structured access.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query on zlúčenie/splynutie + MS SR guidance page
queries_used: Obchodný vestník Slovensko zlúčenie splynutie zápis do obchodného registra justice.gov.sk obchodny vestnik
obchodnyvestnik.justice.gov.sk portál vyhľadávanie konkurzy premeny účtovné závierky vestník

candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory repository of financial statements and annual reports (výročné správy) from 2013 onwards, run by DataCentrum under the Ministry of Finance. Annual reports of banks and payment institutions carry organisational structure, headcount (priemerný počet zamestnancov), board/supervisory-board composition and remuneration, subsidiary lists and post-balance-sheet events — i.e. the documentary backing for hiring and org-change analysis. Filing dates are themselves events.
candidates.legal_status: public register under the Accounting Act; free re-use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the RÚZ public REST/OpenData interface (also mirrored by Slovensko.Digital) to list documents per IČO; download new výročná správa / účtovná závierka PDFs and extract headcount and governance sections. Poll monthly; peak filing mid-year.
queries_used: register účtovných závierok Slovensko banka výročná správa registeruz.sk

candidates.source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) — rýchle/rozšírené vyhľadávanie
candidates.why_relevant: Any bank, PSP or IT/payments vendor contracting with the Slovak state must be registered with its konečný užívateľ výhod (UBO) and oprávnená osoba, backed by verification documents (verifikačný dokument) that narrate the ownership and control chain — often in more detail than the commercial register. UBO and 'verifikácia' filings are dated events that reveal quiet ownership and control changes. Register maintained by MS SR, registering court Okresný súd Žilina.
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 315/2016 Z. z.; structured data published as OpenData
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the published OpenData/structured export for bulk, plus targeted rozšírené vyhľadávanie for watchlist entities; download verifikačné dokumenty (PDF) and diff UBO sets and oprávnená osoba between versions.
queries_used: register partnerov verejného sektora RPVS vyhľadávanie konečný užívateľ výhod rpvs.gov.sk

candidates.source_name: Register právnických osôb, podnikateľov a orgánov verejnej moci (RPO) — ŠÚ SR
candidates.why_relevant: The Statistical Office's reference register consolidates data from source registers (commercial, trade, associations) and — crucially for this cell — carries the SK NACE classification that ORSR itself does not let you search by. This is the mechanism for enumerating the entire population of SK-registered financial and payment actors (SK NACE 64.19 iné peňažné sprostredkovanie, 64.99, 66.19, 66.12, 63.11) before drilling into each in ORSR.
candidates.access_status: free_public_no_login; no login required for search
candidates.legal_status: CC BY 4.0 per ŠÚ SR licensing of RPO data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Call the REST API (https://api.statistics.sk/rpo/v1/) to enumerate entities by SK NACE and by establishment/termination date; use resulting IČO list to seed ORSR / RÚZ / Obchodný vestník watchlists. Attribute CC BY 4.0.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search for SK NACE / open-data access to the register population
queries_used: register právnických osôb RPO štatistický úrad SK NACE vyhľadávanie api data.gov.sk obchodný register open data

candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable contract for the RPO REST API: endpoints, filters (including changes since a date), response schema. Determines whether an automated org-change monitor can be built cheaply against the state register rather than by scraping.
candidates.legal_status: public documentation for a CC BY 4.0 dataset
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to design the collector; re-check quarterly for API version changes.

candidates.source_name: Ekosystém Slovensko.Digital — otvorené dáta a API (Datahub)
candidates.why_relevant: Civic-tech aggregator that republishes the exact registers in this cell in usable form: RPO and RPO V2, Obchodný vestník, Register účtovných závierok, Centrálny register zmlúv, plus Sociálna poisťovňa / VšZP debtor lists. Offers REST APIs, an SQL API for analytical queries, and weekly full SQL dumps — the fastest path to a cross-register org-change feed without scraping eight state sites. Debtor lists (Sociálna poisťovňa) are also an indirect headcount/distress signal.
candidates.access_status: free tier with rate limit (documented as 60 req/min per IP unauthenticated); premium tiers paid
candidates.legal_status: terms of service published (podmienky-sluzieb); derived from public state registers — check attribution/redistribution terms before storing
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly SQL dump ingestion for the base population; REST/SQL API for incremental change detection on watchlist IČOs. Review podmienky-sluzieb for the free tier before production use.
candidates.discovered_via_method: open-data search then snowball across its service pages

candidates.source_name: FinStat.sk — profil firmy: Obchodný register a Udalosti vo firme
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that normalises ~13 state sources (OR SR, Obchodný vestník, ŽR SR, RÚZ, tax office, RPVS) into a per-company event timeline ('Udalosti vo firme') covering statutory-body changes, share-capital moves, liquidations and RPVS changes, with email alerting and an API. Fastest way to detect a change; its value is timeliness and normalisation, but every event must be traced back to ORSR/Vestník for the authoritative date.
candidates.access_status: free profile pages (partial); monitoring, export and API require paid Premium/ULTIMATE
candidates.legal_status: commercial ToS; bulk scraping of the free site likely prohibited — licence the API instead
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Licence FinStat MONITORING/API and subscribe a watchlist of bank and payment-firm IČOs to statutory-body and RPVS event types; do not scrape. Use as trigger, confirm in ORSR.

candidates.source_name: NBS — Registre dohľadu nad finančným trhom (vrátane registra podľa PSD2)
candidates.why_relevant: Cross-check pointer for this cell: NBS's supervisory registers define which IČOs are actually banks, branches of foreign banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions and agents under PSD2. Intersecting that authoritative population with the SK NACE-derived RPO list keeps the ORSR watchlist both complete and free of irrelevant entities; NBS licence/withdrawal decisions also pre-date or explain register entries (new subsidiary, branch closure).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic snapshot of the supervised-entity and PSD2 register listings; map names to IČO via RPO; diff to detect new/removed licensed entities. (Detailed NBS coverage belongs to the regulator cell — used here as a population pointer.)

negative_findings.description: ORSR's own public search does not support full-text search by predmet podnikania or by SK NACE code. Fetching https://www.orsr.sk/search_subjekt.asp showed the available criteria to be: obchodné meno, právna forma, registrový súd, and — via separate pages — IČO, sídlo, spisová značka, and priezvisko/meno osoby. There is no activity-code filter.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell hypothesis that ORSR itself can enumerate the SK financial/payments population by NACE is not supported; that capability sits in the ŠÚ SR RPO register/API instead, which carries SK NACE.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Population enumeration must be built as RPO(SK NACE) -> IČO list -> ORSR per-entity monitoring, or via the NBS supervised-entity lists, not by querying ORSR directly. Designing the collector the other way round would silently miss most actors.

negative_findings.description: No official ORSR-side push feed (RSS/webhook/'recently changed entries' listing) for statutory-body changes was found in either Slovak or English searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Change detection appears to require either periodic diffing of per-entity extracts, ingestion of the Obchodný vestník, or a commercial aggregator (FinStat) / civic aggregator (Slovensko.Digital) that does the diffing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection cost and latency for this cell are driven by polling design; budget for diff-based monitoring rather than assuming a subscribe-able feed. Unverified whether the new sluzby.orsr.sk portal exposes such an endpoint.

negative_findings.description: Re-use and rate-limit terms were not verified first-hand for orsr.sk, registeruz.sk and obchodnyvestnik.justice.gov.sk (no robots.txt or ToS fetched in this pass). Slovensko.Digital's rate limit and FinStat's paid tiers are known only from their own marketing/service pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access/legal_status values for the state portals are stated from statutory context, not from a fetched policy document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Before production scraping, robots.txt and terms for each state portal should be read, and the Slovensko.Digital podmienky-sluzieb reviewed, to avoid building a collector on unverified permission.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak register-side vocabulary exists for 'hiring' or 'jobs' below board level — registers record only štatutárny orgán, prokúra, dozorná rada, vedúci organizačnej zložky and (via RÚZ annual reports) priemerný počet zamestnancov.
negative_findings.result_summary: This cell can evidence leadership moves and headcount aggregates, but not recruitment or mid-level hiring.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Jobs/hiring topics in this run must be carried by other A5 cells (job boards, LinkedIn-type sources, press); registers should not be over-claimed as a hiring signal.

coverage_gaps.description: No concrete watchlist of SK bank / payment-institution / fintech IČOs was assembled in this pass; candidates are the plumbing, not the actor list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run RPO API queries for SK NACE 64.19, 64.92, 64.99, 66.12, 66.19, 63.11 and intersect with the NBS supervised-entity and PSD2 registers to produce a durable IČO watchlist keyed for all register collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage of organizačná zložka / pobočka zahraničnej banky (branches of foreign banks and EU payment firms passporting into SK) is asserted but not demonstrated — no branch-specific register view was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test ORSR entity pages for entities of type 'podnik zahraničnej osoby / organizačná zložka' and cross-check against the NBS passporting/branch lists and the home-state register via BRIS; document how branch establishment and closure surface in ORSR.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unclear how far back ORSR 'úplný výpis' exposes deleted officers, and RÚZ is documented as mandatory only from accounting period 2013 onwards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe úplný výpis for two or three long-lived SK banks to establish the practical historical horizon for officer-level time series, and note the 2013 RÚZ floor in any longitudinal analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: The Obchodný vestník 'Konkurzy a reštrukturalizácie' section was seen in search results but not examined as a distinct sub-stream, and no separate SK insolvency register was assessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess the Vestník insolvency section and any Register úpadcov equivalent as a dedicated stream for detecting distress-driven org change in SK fintech/payment vendors.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature: orsr.sk, registeruz.sk, rpvs.gov.sk and Obchodný vestník are Slovak-only in substance, with only BRIS/e-Justice and vendor marketing pages in English.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept Slovak as the working language for this cell; budget for sk-language parsing (diacritics, -ová surname forms, legal-form abbreviations a.s. / s.r.o. / o.z.) rather than seeking English mirrors that do not exist.

brief: Slovakia's statutory record of organisational change is unusually well plumbed but fragmented across four state systems: ORSR (orsr.sk, plus the newer sluzby.orsr.sk portal) holds the dated ground truth on štatutárny orgán, prokúra, dozorná rada, organizačné zložky and share capital; Obchodný vestník publishes projekty premien and general-meeting notices roughly a month ahead of the register entry, making it the earliest legal warning of a merger or restructuring; Register účtovných závierok supplies the annual reports with headcount and governance detail; and RPVS adds verified UBO/control chains for anyone contracting with the state. The critical structural finding is that ORSR itself cannot be searched by SK NACE — the population of SK banks, payment institutions and fintechs must be enumerated through the ŠÚ SR RPO register and its CC BY 4.0 REST API (cross-checked against NBS supervisory registers), then monitored entity-by-entity in ORSR. Because no official change feed exists, collection means diffing: either self-built polling of the state portals, or riding the Slovensko.Digital open-data hub (APIs plus weekly SQL dumps of RPO, Vestník and RÚZ) and, for latency, the paid FinStat monitoring feed, always tracing each event back to the register for its authoritative date. Everything of evidentiary value here is Slovak-language only; English exists solely as a BRIS/e-Justice gateway.
